name: ImageAll Embroidery
old_description: We're thrilled to launch our standard collection, feature designs that reflect Rapid City's energy as the Gateway to the Black Hills. Soft fabrics, versatile style, and nods to local icons - these tees pair easygoing comfort with regional pride.
about:
ImageAll Embroidery operates from Rapid City, South Dakota, where it provides custom apparel decoration services to businesses and organizations. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, and custom design work, applying those services to a range of blank apparel including T-shirts, sweatshirts, polos, jackets, headwear, and youth sizes. It also offers screen printing, according to its homepage. Orders are fulfilled through a company showroom and online ordering portal, with no minimum quantity required for most items (hard-good promotional products excepted). Volume discounts are available for larger runs.

ImageAll serves customers needing branded workwear, promotional merchandise, and custom team or event apparel. Its catalog lineup includes a Spring 2026 collection, an Essentials catalog, and a dedicated Workwear guide, indicating a focus on outfitting crews and corporate programs. The company also markets a standard collection of ready-made designs that reference Rapid City's identity as the gateway to the Black Hills.

The business emphasizes rapid turnaround, fast and reliable service, secure payment processing, and a no-minimum-order policy as its primary differentiators.
